QuestInfo.name: [Henesys Ruins] Jay and the Quest for Power
QuestInfo.0: #bJay#k in Henesys appeared as you were helping Anne in #bMutant Tiru Forest#k. What brings him here?
QuestInfo.1: It seems Jay came to train with Anne and extract the essence of black magic. He needs #b40 Mutant Tiguru Feathers#k.
QuestInfo.2: Jay and Anne aim to get rid of the corrupted Cygnus.

0.0: It's you. We meet again. You helped Anne, huh?

yes.0: Then I'll leave it to you.

no.0: I understand. Please talk to me again if you change your mind.

0.1: I came here on business. I'm going to practice magic and train with Anne. Eventually, we'll have what it takes to get rid of Cygnus.
0.2: Could you do me a favor if you have the time? Please get me #b40 Mutant Tiguru Feathers#k in Ereve Forest. Am I going to make arrows with them? Haha... No, I'm not.
0.3: Last time, I discovered how to absorb the black magic extracted from the mutant monsters. However, it must be a special material: the Tiguru Feather.

yes.0: Whatever the price, I will grow stronger, defeat the Cygnus Knights, and bring peace to Maple World!
